title: Adversarial review of draft v26 and evidence-aligned title recommendations
summary: Completed v26 adversarial manuscript review and title shortlist; substantive clarification still needed before submission.
notes: Read all 38 PDF pages and appendices, inspected Figures 2, 5 and 8, compared the v22 review, and checked selected analysis code, saved validation summary and frozen confirmation plan. Reviewed PDF SHA256: 5f37d7150a251b381ca1f1e5b4734dd304fabd60ed7ffd122027d24d68c2299e. Improvements: explicit Gaussian and Fisher approximations, full-grid sensitivity check, method-neutral operating point, tier-mixing baseline, DeepVigor discussion, no unmeasured speedup claim in results. Remaining findings: schematic event/background crossover is not an empirically established physical transition; Gaussian-only agrees on 436/443 mask signs versus hybrid 437/443; frozen plan says measured target summaries were already read, unlike blanket manuscript prospective wording; Eq1 requires ideal suppression or factor p minus residual probability for TMR; signed task-risk differences are not AVF probabilities; use fixed full-grid correction as primary and label sampled regime classification accurately; distinguish the close cost-matched INT8 benchmark in reference 3; mechanism thresholds are point estimates on a coarse grid; remove unproved cheap-objective and universal-ranking language. Suggested titles: The Many-Bit Problem: A Statistical Model of Faults in Quantized Neural Networks; When Bits Add Up: Modeling Faults and Protection in Quantized Neural Networks. No inference, source data, database or manuscript changed. This was not a full archival audit.
